{{Quote|Space station ''Valor'', this is Colonel Meebur Gascon. Can anyone hear me?|Meebur Gascon|<ref name="Point" />}}
'''''Valor''''' was a [[space station]] that served within the [[Republic Military|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. At some point in the war, ''Valor'' was stationed in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Carida]] in the region known as the [[Colonies]], where it was utilized as the site of a [[Republic strategy conference]], where high-ranking military [[Republic officer|officers]], including members of the [[Jedi Order]]'s [[Jedi High Council|leading council]], conferred to discuss the war and its procedures. However, the conference was instead halted as a result of an [[Carida incident|attempt]] to destroy the space station launched by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
[[File:ValorStationPeltedByDebris-PoNR.png|thumb|left|250px|''Valor'' being pelted by debris from the destroyed cruiser ''Renown'']]
''Valor'' was a [[space station]] situated in the orbit of the [[planet]] [[Carida]] of the [[Carida system|star system]] of the same name,<ref name="Point" /> within the regions known as the [[Colonies]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> The space station was also equipped with a series of at least six [[hangar]] bays, as well as [[Comm unit|communications]] and [[Scanner|scanning]] systems. On its interior, ''Valor'' retained a room designated for military strategy conferences, which possessed a [[Holotable|holographic projection table]] within the center of a pit of staircases and seating areas for participants, as well as several projection screens which displayed a layout of the space station. It also possessed a series of [[viewport]]s which provided the crew with a view of the surrounding [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Point" />

==History==
[[File:Venator-I-FFG.png|thumb|right|220px|A ''Venator I''-class Star Destroyer patrols near ''Valor'' over Carida]]
At some point during the [[Clone Wars]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], ''Valor'' was stationed in orbit of the planet Carida. While in the planet's orbit, the space station was protected by a force of several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]],<ref name="Point" /> including at least one [[Venator I-class Star Destroyer|''Venator I''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="Venator I">{{Armada|set=Venator-class Star Destroyer Expansion Pack|cardname=''Venator I''-class Star Destroyer}}</ref> and [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]], as a result of the Republic's organization of a strategy conference. The conference, which was to discuss the ongoing war aboard ''Valor'', was attended by several of high-ranking [[Republic officer|officers]] of the government's [[Republic Navy|naval forces]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]], including [[Jedi General]]s [[Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], as well as [[Admiral]]s [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[Barton Coburn]], and [[Clone Commander]]s [[Cody|CC-2224]] and [[Neyo|CC-8826]].<ref name="Point" />

However, in an attempt to destroy ''Valor'' and hinder the strategy conference, the Confederacy launched a [[Renown|stolen]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], which the confederate government had loaded with several canisters of [[rhydonium]], a highly explosive [[starship]] [[fuel]], to the Carida [[Star system|system]] from the planet [[Abafar]]. Despite their efforts, the Republic astromech droid, [[R2-D2]], of the commissioned [[D-Squad]] of [[droid]]s, was able to prematurely detonate the [[Star Destroyer]] and its complement of rhydonium prior to reaching ''Valor'', which resulted in damage dealt to the space station, and the destruction of a nearby ''Arquitens''-class cruiser.<ref name="Point" />

==Commanders and crew==
''Valor'' was maintained by a crew of several [[clone navigation officer]]s.<ref name="Point" /> It was also operated by Admiral Tarkin's [[R5 series astromech droid]],<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/point-of-no-return-episode-guide|text="Point of No Return" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> [[Z9]].<ref name="Point" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Valor-Concept.png|thumb|right|220px|Concept art of ''Valor'']]
''Valor'' was introduced in "[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]," the thirteenth episode of the fifth season of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 12]], [[2013]].<ref name="TCW Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Concept art for ''Valor'' was illustrated by [[Pat Presley]] and was titled as "Republic Star Base."<ref name="Concept">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/point-of-no-return-concept-art-gallery|text="Point of No Return" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}}</ref> The design used for the space station was inspired by [[Spaceport THX1138]], the station featured within the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride owned by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]].<ref name="Insider 138">{{InsiderCite|138|Launchpad|Launch Pad}}</ref> An image of the ''Valor'' was reused to depict an [[Unidentified hidden Imperial base|Imperial base]] in the web browser game ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Strike Missions]]''.<ref name="Strike Missions">{{SW|url=games-apps/disneyxd-star-wars-rebels-strike-missions|text=''Star Wars Rebels: Strike Missions''|int=Star Wars Rebels: Strike Missions|nolive=1}}</ref>
